nodes.title: Main Prompt · complete Ideogram caption
How to use
widgets_values:
# Ideogram 4 · LITE · Generate

This template uses a complete, editable JSON caption and needs no separate language model. Edit the overall scene, style, background and object descriptions together in Main Prompt. Bboxes are [top,left,bottom,right] from 0 to 1000, not visible frames. Keep JSON punctuation valid. For artwork, use aesthetics, lighting, medium, art_style instead of the photographic style fields.

For ordinary text requests that are automatically structured, use E2GO_Ideogram4_Generate_full.json with Enhanced selected. LITE does not invent object descriptions from plain text.

Choose matching conditional/unconditional weights, Qwen3-VL 8B image encoder and Flux2 VAE. Set size and batch in Resolution, then Queue. Defaults: 20 steps, CFG 7, Euler; native resolution-dependent sigmas and late CFG 3 from 70%. Negative text is unused.

## Sampling choice
In Powder Sampler, Ideogram sampling offers Standard (default) and First sigma +0.005 (experimental). The alternative changes only the first sampled sigma, preserves the step count and does not change your caption or model weights. It may help with gray placeholders, but can change composition or introduce artifacts. Compare with the same fixed seed. Restart ComfyUI after updating to see the new control.
